dedupe_keys.name: ifcopenshell open source ifc toolkit and geometry engine

description: IfcOpenShell is an open-source IFC toolkit and geometry engine for reading, writing and modifying Building Information Models in the Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) schema, used to build digital platforms for the built environment. It works on Windows, macOS and Linux from C++ or Python, headless on servers or through native IFC authoring interfaces; it supports the IFC2X3, IFC4 and IFC4X3 schemas or custom schemas at run time, and the IFC-SPF, IFCJSON, IFCXML, IFCHDF5 and IFCSQL formats. A high-level API covers hundreds of authoring tasks such as copying objects, cost calculation or 4D simulation, the geometry engine converts parametric geometry, including booleans and sweeps, into explicit geometry for other CAD systems, and it generates annotated 2D drawings from 3D models. The ecosystem includes clash detection, model comparison, conversion to more than ten formats and support for IDS, BCF and bSDD, with documentation, user guides and courses, and the project says hundreds of developers contribute. Coverage: generic. Access: free download of release 0.8.5. Licence: GNU LGPL version 3. Caveats: the quality of results depends on the IFC files, which often lack the attributes simulations need. Simulation uses: extracting building geometry, spaces and assets from BIM for energy, evacuation and asset models, and scripting BIM-based digital twins. Related records: IFC, the buildingSMART sample files and gbXML.
